root_cause.text: The idle-skip optimization in the exec queue suspend path bypassed the GuC suspend operation, preventing the GPU from performing the context switch that flushes TLB entries for invalidated userptr VMAs in LR/preempt-fence VM mode.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description explicitly states "The idle-skip optimization bypasses GuC suspend, so the GPU may not perform the context switch that flushes TLB entries for invalidated userptr VMAs. In LR/preempt-fence VM mode, this can lead to missed TLB invalidation and page faults during userptr invalidation tests." The patch removes the `EXEC_QUEUE_STATE_IDLE_SKIP_SUSPEND` state flag and the conditional logic that skipped suspend operations when queues were idle (visible in the removal of `if (!idle_skip_suspend && guc_exec_queue_allowed_to_change_state(q)...)` and related idle-skip handling code), restoring unconditional schedule toggling to ensure the context-switch TLB flush always occurs.

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove unused static inline helper function `xe_exec_queue_idle_skip_suspend()` and its documentation from the public header.
intent_record.what: Removed a static inline function `xe_exec_queue_idle_skip_suspend()` along with its documentation comment block from the header file. The function checked if an exec queue was non-parallel and idle.
intent_record.how: This change removes a utility function that was previously available to callers. Any code that relied on this function to determine if an exec queue could skip suspend steps will no longer have access to it, potentially requiring those callers to be updated or the logic to be inlined elsewhere.

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove unused EXEC_QUEUE_STATE_IDLE_SKIP_SUSPEND flag definition that is no longer needed.
intent_record.what: Removed the macro definition `#define EXEC_QUEUE_STATE_IDLE_SKIP_SUSPEND (1 << 11)` from the exec_queue state flags enumeration.
intent_record.how: This eliminates a bit flag constant that was previously available for marking execution queues with an idle-skip-suspend state. Any code attempting to use this flag will now fail to compile, preventing its use throughout the codebase.

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove unused helper functions for managing the EXEC_QUEUE_STATE_IDLE_SKIP_SUSPEND state flag to reduce code complexity.
intent_record.what: Removed three static inline functions: exec_queue_idle_skip_suspend(), set_exec_queue_idle_skip_suspend(), and clear_exec_queue_idle_skip_suspend() that manipulate the EXEC_QUEUE_STATE_IDLE_SKIP_SUSPEND flag in the queue's atomic state.
intent_record.how: This eliminates unused helper functions that provided read, set, and clear operations on the EXEC_QUEUE_STATE_IDLE_SKIP_SUSPEND state flag. Any code paths that previously relied on these functions to check or modify this flag will no longer be able to do so, effectively removing support for the idle-skip-suspend state management feature.

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove unnecessary idle/suspend check to ensure ring tail is always updated for non-parallel execution queues.
intent_record.what: Removed the conditional check `!exec_queue_idle_skip_suspend(q)` from an else-if statement, converting it to a bare else clause that unconditionally calls `xe_lrc_set_ring_tail(lrc, lrc->ring.tail)`.
intent_record.how: Previously, the ring tail was only set when the execution queue was not idle or not skipping suspend. Now it is always set in the non-parallel queue path. This ensures the ring tail is updated regardless of the queue's idle or suspend-skip state, potentially fixing cases where the tail update was incorrectly skipped.

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove idle_skip_suspend condition to ensure exec queue suspension is always processed when state change is allowed.
intent_record.what: Removed the local variable `idle_skip_suspend` and its initialization via `xe_exec_queue_idle_skip_suspend(q)`, and removed the `!idle_skip_suspend` condition from the if statement. The remaining conditions were reordered for line length.
intent_record.how: The function now unconditionally proceeds to the wait_event block if the queue is allowed to change state, is not suspended, and is enabled. Previously, it would skip this block if `idle_skip_suspend` returned true. This changes the suspension behavior by removing a conditional bypass that was preventing suspension in certain idle states.

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove idle skip suspend optimization and sched_context() function, likely consolidating or simplifying the GuC execution queue scheduling logic.
intent_record.what: Removed two code blocks: (1) a conditional check for `idle_skip_suspend` that called `set_exec_queue_idle_skip_suspend(q)` within the suspend message handler, and (2) the entire `sched_context()` function which sent a XE_GUC_ACTION_SCHED_CONTEXT command to the GuC with associated assertions and ring tail setup.
intent_record.how: The removal eliminates the idle skip suspend optimization path during queue suspension and deletes a function that was responsible for scheduling context updates via the GuC. This means queues will no longer attempt to skip suspension when idle, and the sched_context() function is no longer available for callers (likely inlined, moved, or its functionality replaced elsewhere).

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove idle-skip-suspend state handling from the queue resume path to simplify the resume logic.
intent_record.what: Removed three conditional blocks that checked and cleared the exec_queue_idle_skip_suspend flag: (1) a block within the !exec_queue_enabled(q) condition that cleared the flag and called xe_lrc_set_ring_tail, (2) an else-if block that cleared the flag and called sched_context, and (3) a single clear_exec_queue_idle_skip_suspend call in the else branch.
intent_record.how: This change eliminates the special handling for idle-skip-suspend state during queue resume operations. Previously, the code would conditionally restore ring tail state or reschedule the context based on whether idle-skip-suspend was set. Now, resume operations proceed directly to setting resume_time and enabling scheduling without these intermediate state checks, simplifying the resume path and potentially removing redundant or obsolete state management logic.

intent_record.intent_summary: Simplify queue suspension logic by removing idle_skip_suspend state tracking and unconditionally setting need_resume to true for all queues in fault mode.
intent_record.what: Removed the `idle_skip_suspend` variable and its associated logic. Simplified the conditional check from `!idle_skip_suspend && has_deps` to just `has_deps`. Removed the conditional stats increment for `XE_GT_STATS_ID_HW_ENGINE_GROUP_SKIP_LR_QUEUE_COUNT`. Changed `need_resume |= !idle_skip_suspend` to `need_resume = true`.
intent_record.how: The function now unconditionally sets `need_resume = true` for each queue in fault mode (instead of conditionally based on `idle_skip_suspend`), and removes the early return condition that checked both `idle_skip_suspend` and `has_deps`. The stats tracking for skipped queues is eliminated. This means the function will always mark resume as needed and will only return -EAGAIN if `has_deps` is true, regardless of the queue's idle skip suspend state.

bic_trace_step.reason: The commit introduces the idle-skip optimization that is the root cause of the vulnerability. Specifically: (1) A new flag EXEC_QUEUE_STATE_IDLE_SKIP_SUSPEND is added to track when an exec queue can skip suspend operations. (2) In __guc_exec_queue_process_msg_suspend(), the condition is modified to check `!idle_skip_suspend` before performing the GuC suspend operation (line 1926-1927), allowing the function to skip the suspend entirely for idle queues. The fix attempts to re-enable scheduling during resume, but this does not guarantee the same TLB flush behavior as the original suspend path. The vulnerable construct (bypassing GuC suspend for idle queues) is clearly present and not adequately fixed by the resume-time handling.

This directly addresses the vulnerability by ensuring the GuC suspend operation is always performed during TDR, not skipped via idle-skip optimization.
